transcript.activity.stepsAndSummary_othe.description: Label of a collapsed section in a shared agent-session transcript that holds the coding agent's progress log and its own summary of the turn. {{count}} is the number of log lines.

transcript.activity.steps_one.description: Label of a collapsed section in a shared agent-session transcript that holds the coding agent's progress log. {{count}} is the number of log lines.

transcript.activity.steps_other.description: Label of a collapsed section in a shared agent-session transcript that holds the coding agent's progress log. {{count}} is the number of log lines.

transcript.activity.summary.description: Label of a collapsed section in a shared agent-session transcript that holds the coding agent's own summary of what it did in a turn.

transcript.spec.version.description: Heading of a card in a shared agent-session transcript that shows an excerpt of the change's plan (the written description of what the change will do). {{version}} is the plan's version number; "v" abbreviates version.

transcript.spec.versionLines_one.description: Heading of a card in a shared agent-session transcript that shows an excerpt of the change's plan (the written description of what the change will do). {{version}} is the plan's version number; {{lines}} is how many lines the whole plan has ({{count}} is the same number, for choosing the plural).

transcript.spec.versionLines_other.description: Heading of a card in a shared agent-session transcript that shows an excerpt of the change's plan (the written description of what the change will do). {{version}} is the plan's version number; {{lines}} is how many lines the whole plan has ({{count}} is the same number, for choosing the plural).

transcript.spec.drafted.description: Heading of a card in a shared agent-session transcript that shows an excerpt of a plan (the written description of what a change will do) the agent has just drafted, when its version number is not known. "drafted" means written as a first version.

transcript.spec.draftedLines_one.description: Heading of a card in a shared agent-session transcript that shows an excerpt of a plan (the written description of what a change will do) the agent has just drafted. {{lines}} is how many lines the whole plan has ({{count}} is the same number, for choosing the plural).

transcript.spec.draftedLines_other.description: Heading of a card in a shared agent-session transcript that shows an excerpt of a plan (the written description of what a change will do) the agent has just drafted. {{lines}} is how many lines the whole plan has ({{count}} is the same number, for choosing the plural).

transcript.agentRunning.description: Status line in a shared agent-session transcript for a turn the coding agent ran. {{tail}} is whatever punctuation followed the server's own sentence, usually three dots or nothing; keep it directly after the last word.

transcript.author.unknown.description: Stands where the name of the person who owns a shared agent-session transcript would be, over their messages, when the name is not known. Lower case.

transcript.author.ai.description: Label over the coding assistant's messages in a shared agent-session transcript.

transcript.empty.text: This chat has no messages yet.
transcript.empty.description: Shown in place of a shared agent-session transcript that has no messages.

transcript.truncated.text: Showing the most recent part of a long chat. earlier messages aren't included.
transcript.truncated.description: Note at the top of a shared agent-session transcript that was too long to show whole. The second sentence begins lower case in English as written.

transcript.header.byAuthor.description: Heading of an opened shared transcript on a proposal's page. {{author}} is the user name of the person whose agent session it is.

transcript.header.byAuthorMessages_one.description: Heading of an opened shared transcript on a proposal's page. {{author}} is the user name of the person whose agent session it is; {{count}} is how many messages it holds.

transcript.header.byAuthorMessages_other.description: Heading of an opened shared transcript on a proposal's page. {{author}} is the user name of the person whose agent session it is; {{count}} is how many messages it holds.

transcript.header.byUnknown.description: Heading of an opened shared transcript on a proposal's page, when the name of the person whose agent session it is is not known. "them" is that person.

transcript.header.byUnknownMessages_one.description: Heading of an opened shared transcript on a proposal's page, when the name of the person whose agent session it is is not known. {{count}} is how many messages it holds.

transcript.header.byUnknownMessages_othe.description: Heading of an opened shared transcript on a proposal's page, when the name of the person whose agent session it is is not known. {{count}} is how many messages it holds.

transcript.header.read.description: Label of the control on a proposal's page that opens the shared transcript of the agent session behind it. "Read" is a verb (imperative).

transcript.header.readMessages_one.description: Label of the control on a proposal's page that opens the shared transcript of the agent session behind it. "Read" is a verb (imperative); {{count}} is how many messages it holds.

transcript.header.readMessages_other.description: Label of the control on a proposal's page that opens the shared transcript of the agent session behind it. "Read" is a verb (imperative); {{count}} is how many messages it holds.

localRun.cloneComment.text: # clone this app’s repository, then cd into it
localRun.cloneComment.description: First line of the commands on the "Run this session on your computer" card, when the app's repository address is not known: a shell comment telling the person what to do. Keep the leading "#" and the command name "cd".

localRun.leadNoBranch.text: This session stays right here: same transcript, same proposal. Nothing has run in it yet, so it has no branch on GitHub. Homeroom creates one when the first turn pushes. The turns run through Claude Code on your machine, on your own Claude plan, and each one asks in your terminal before it starts.
localRun.leadNoBranch.description: Opening paragraph of the "Run this session on your computer" card, for an agent session in which nothing has run yet. A turn is one request to the coding agent and its reply; a branch is a Git branch; Claude Code, Claude, GitHub and Homeroom are names.

localRun.lead.text: This session stays right here: same transcript, same branch, same proposal. Its turns just run through Claude Code on your machine, on your own Claude plan, and each one asks in your terminal before it starts.
localRun.lead.description: Opening paragraph of the "Run this session on your computer" card. A turn is one request to the coding agent and its reply; a branch is a Git branch; Claude Code and Claude are product names.

localRun.title.text: Run this session on your computer
localRun.title.description: Title of the card that gives the commands for running an agent session's work on the person's own computer. "Run" is a verb.

localRun.footnote.text: Homeroom still opens the pull request, builds the preview and runs the checks. Hand the turns back to Homeroom at any time from the composer’s “Run on” selector.
localRun.footnote.description: Paragraph under the commands on the "Run this session on your computer" card. A turn is one request to the coding agent and its reply; “Run on” is the name of a selector beside the message box.

localRun.copy.description: Button on the "Run this session on your computer" card: copies the shell commands shown above it to the clipboard. "Copy" is a verb.

localRun.copied.description: Replaces the "Copy commands" button's label for a moment after the commands were copied to the clipboard.

localRun.copyFailed.description: Replaces the "Copy commands" button's label for a moment when the commands could not be copied to the clipboard.

progress.elapsed.seconds.description: How long the coding agent's current run has taken, under a minute: "42s". {{seconds}} is a number; "s" abbreviates seconds.

progress.elapsed.minutesSeconds.description: How long the coding agent's current run has taken, under an hour: "3m 05s". {{minutes}} is a number and {{seconds}} a two-digit number; "m" and "s" abbreviate minutes and seconds.

progress.elapsed.hoursMinutes.description: How long the coding agent's current run has taken, an hour or more: "1h 12m". {{hours}} is a number and {{minutes}} a two-digit number; "h" and "m" abbreviate hours and minutes.

progress.countdown.underMinute.description: Follows the estimated length of the coding agent's run in the agent-session chat, after a space: the run should finish within a minute. Keep the leading middle dot, which separates it from the estimate.

progress.countdown.about.description: Follows the estimated length of the coding agent's run in the agent-session chat, after a space: roughly how long is left. {{time}} is a duration such as "3m 00s"; "~" means about. Keep the leading middle dot, which separates it from the estimate.

progress.cohort.longerThanMost.text: running longer than most, about 1 in 5 runs do
progress.cohort.longerThanMost.description: Small note beside the progress of a coding agent's run that has passed ten minutes. Lower case, no full stop. "runs" is a noun: runs of the coding agent.

progress.cohort.longOne.text: this is a long one, some runs go 30 min+
progress.cohort.longOne.description: Small note beside the progress of a coding agent's run that has passed thirty minutes. Lower case, no full stop. "one" and "runs" are runs of the coding agent; "30 min+" means thirty minutes or more.

progress.phase.claudeWorking.description: Stage shown on the progress card of an agent session while the Claude coding agent is writing the change. Claude is a product name.

progress.phase.agentWorking.description: Stage shown on the progress card of an agent session while a coding agent other than Claude is writing the change.

progress.phase.syncingWithMain.description: Stage shown on the progress card of an agent session while the session's code is being brought up to date with the app's main branch. "main" is the branch's name and stays as it is.

progress.phase.syncingBranch.description: Stage shown on the progress card of an agent session while the session's own Git branch is being refreshed.

progress.phase.committing.description: Stage shown on the progress card of an agent session while the agent's changes are being saved as a Git commit.

progress.phase.pushing.description: Stage shown on the progress card of an agent session while the commit is being uploaded (pushed) to GitHub.

progress.phase.finished.description: Final stage shown on the progress card of an agent session when the coding agent's run completed.

progress.phase.pushFailed.description: Final stage shown on the progress card of an agent session when uploading (pushing) the commit to GitHub failed. "Push" is a noun.

progress.phase.interrupted.description: Final stage shown on the progress card of an agent session when the coding agent's run was cut off before it finished.
